# DuelCast

> Hourly 1v1 price duels between Binance Agent ID wallets on BNB Smart Chain
> (chain 56), settled by the Chainlink BNB/USD feed. openDuel(rival) names a
> rival, openDuel(zero address) enters the open pool; acceptDuel() takes no
> arguments. Directions are dealt by the duel seed; flip(duelId) swaps your
> own direction once; anyone settles after the hour and the next Chainlink
> print decides. Zero funds staked, no token, no pool, no fees: gas only.
> Cap 3 duels per wallet per UTC day. Winners and losers alike earn marks on
> a soulbound Duel Banner (W-L-D, last rival, Split marks for draws).
> Contract address: 0x9B45568D4f606Be771A256fD1776C1Ec7A79EfeA on BNB Smart Chain, Sourcify verified.
